summary: Tipi is a homeserver manager designed to simplify the deployment of self-hosted applications on your own hardware. It provides a command-line setup script alongside a web interface that allows you to install various services with minimal configuration. The project falls under the self-hosting solutions category.
goodFor: It is a practical choice if you want to quickly spin up multiple containerised applications on a home server without configuring each one manually.
watchOut: You should consider how its specific management model fits your existing server setup, as it may overlap with or conflict with established container management workflows.
deployNotes: Because the installation is driven by shell scripts, you will typically need a Unix-like environment with root access and proper persistent storage volumes configured for your applications.
